competitor_context.headline: Yaskawa Electric FY2026 Q1: orders +29%, but robot segment operating profit plunges 82% on system migration costs
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Yaskawa's robot-segment profit collapse despite order growth highlights that FANUC's ability to convert its own order strength into raised guidance is a relative competitive advantage right now.

competitor_context.headline: Teradyne posts record Q2 2026 revenue on AI demand, launches new AI test instruments
competitor_context.implication_for_target: Broader AI-driven capex strength across the automation/semiconductor-equipment space (Teradyne's test tools, FANUC's factory robots) suggests the current investment cycle is supporting capital goods demand more broadly, not FANUC-specific.
